# GROW — Agent-Native Website Agency

> We build websites that both humans and AI agents can read, understand, and cite.
> 48-hour delivery. Fixed price. Built for the agent era.

## About

GROW (grow.contact) is an agency specializing in agent-native website design for AI startups
and technical teams. Every site is hand-engineered with semantic HTML, JSON-LD structured data,
and llms.txt compatibility.

## Services

- **Starter** ($2,400) — One-page agent-native website, 48-hour delivery
- **Growth** ($4,800) — Multi-page agent-native website, 5-day delivery
- Both tiers include: semantic markup, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, performance optimization

## Methodology: The Agent Readability Score

We score every site on a 0-100 scale across five signals:
1. Semantic HTML (25%) — Proper use of <nav>, <article>, <section>, <table>
2. JSON-LD coverage (20%) — Structured data on every page
3. llms.txt present (15%) — Root-level crawler README
4. Citability (20%) — Clear positioning statements, quotable content
5. First-contentful speed (20%) — Core HTML loads in <1.5s
